  have lc := der.wf.2.1
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  induction der <;> subst eq
  case var => grind
  case abs => exact Or.inl (Value.abs lc)
  case tabs => exact Or.inl (Value.tabs lc)
  case app l r ih_l ih_r =>
    have := ih_l rfl l.wf.2.1
    have := ih_r rfl r.wf.2.1
    grind [canonical_form_abs]
  case tapp der sub ih =>
    have := ih rfl der.wf.2.1
    grind [canonical_form_tabs]
  case let' der _ ih _ =>
    have := ih rfl der.wf.2.1
    grind
  case inl der _ ih | inr der _ ih =>
    have := ih rfl der.wf.2.1
    grind
  case case der _ _ ih _ _ =>
    have := ih rfl der.wf.2.1
    grind [canonical_form_sum]
  case sub der _ ih => exact ih rfl lc

lemma Typing.progress (der : Typing [] t τ) : t.Value ∨ ∃ t', t ⭢βᵛ t' := by
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  have lc := der.wf.2.1
  induction der <;> subst eq
  case var => simp_all
  case abs => exact .inl (.abs lc)
  case tabs => exact .inl (.tabs lc)
  case app l r ih_l ih_r =>
    have := ih_l rfl l.wf.2.1
    have := ih_r rfl r.wf.2.1
    have := r.wf.2.1
    right
    aesop (add unsafe constructors [Exists, Red]) (add safe forward [canonical_form_abs, Value.lc])
  case tapp der _ ih =>
    cases lc with | tapp lc₁ lc₂ =>
      have := ih rfl lc₁
      right
      aesop (add unsafe constructors [Exists, Red]) (add safe forward [canonical_form_tabs, Value.lc])
  case let' _ _ ih _ =>
    obtain ⟨lc₁, body⟩ := body_let.mp lc
    have := ih rfl lc₁
    right
    aesop (add unsafe constructors [Exists, Red])
  case inl der _ ih | inr der _ ih =>
    have := ih rfl der.wf.2.1
    aesop (add safe constructors Value) (add unsafe constructors [Exists, Red])
  case case der _ _ ih _ _ =>
    obtain ⟨lc₁, body₂, body₃⟩ := body_case.mp lc
    have := ih rfl lc₁
    right
    aesop (add unsafe constructors [Exists, Red]) (add safe cases Value) (add safe forward canonical_form_sum)
  case sub _ _ ih => exact ih rfl lc

lemma Typing.progress (der : Typing [] t τ) : t.Value ∨ ∃ t', t ⭢βᵛ t' := by
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  have lc := der.wf.2.1
  induction der <;> subst eq
  case var => simp_all
  case abs => exact .inl (.abs lc)
  case tabs => exact .inl (.tabs lc)
  case sub _ _ ih => exact ih rfl lc
  case' app l r ih_l ih_r =>
    have lc₂ := r.wf.2.1
    rcases ih_l rfl l.wf.2.1 with val | ⟨_, red⟩
    · obtain ⟨_, _, rfl⟩ := l.canonical_form_abs val
      rcases ih_r rfl lc₂ with val₂ | ⟨_, red₂⟩
  case' tapp der _ ih =>
    cases lc with | tapp lc₁ lc₂ =>
      rcases ih rfl lc₁ with val | ⟨_, red⟩
      · obtain ⟨_, _, rfl⟩ := der.canonical_form_tabs val
  case' let' _ _ ih _ =>
    obtain ⟨lc₁, body⟩ := body_let.mp lc
    rcases ih rfl lc₁ with val | ⟨_, red⟩
  case' inl der _ ih | inr der _ ih =>
    rcases ih rfl der.wf.2.1 with val | ⟨_, red⟩
  case' case der _ _ ih _ _ =>
    obtain ⟨lc₁, body₂, body₃⟩ := body_case.mp lc
    rcases ih rfl lc₁ with val | ⟨_, red⟩
    · obtain ⟨_, h | h⟩ := der.canonical_form_sum val <;> subst h <;> cases val
  all_goals aesop (add safe constructors [Value, Red, Exists]) (add safe forward Value.lc)

lemma Typing.progress (der : Typing [] t τ) : t.Value ∨ ∃ t', t ⭢βᵛ t' := by
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  have lc := der.wf.2.1
  induction der <;> subst eq
  case var => simp_all
  case abs => exact .inl (.abs lc)
  case tabs => exact .inl (.tabs lc)
  case sub _ _ ih => exact ih rfl lc
  case' app l r ih_l ih_r =>
    have lc₂ := r.wf.2.1
    rcases ih_l rfl l.wf.2.1 with val | ⟨_, red⟩
    case' inl =>
      obtain ⟨_, _, rfl⟩ := l.canonical_form_abs val
      rcases ih_r rfl lc₂ with val₂ | ⟨_, red₂⟩
  case' tapp der _ ih =>
    cases lc with | tapp lc₁ lc₂ =>
      rcases ih rfl lc₁ with val | ⟨_, red⟩
      case' inl =>
      obtain ⟨_, _, rfl⟩ := der.canonical_form_tabs val
  case' let' _ _ ih _ =>
    obtain ⟨lc₁, body⟩ := body_let.mp lc
    rcases ih rfl lc₁ with val | ⟨_, red⟩
  case' inl der _ ih | inr der _ ih =>
    rcases ih rfl der.wf.2.1 with val | ⟨_, red⟩
  case' case der _ _ ih _ _ =>
    obtain ⟨lc₁, body₂, body₃⟩ := body_case.mp lc
    rcases ih rfl lc₁ with val | ⟨_, red⟩
    case' inl =>
      obtain ⟨_, h | h⟩ := der.canonical_form_sum val <;> subst h <;> cases val
  all_goals aesop (add safe constructors [Value, Red, Exists]) (add safe forward Value.lc)

lemma Typing.progress (der : Typing [] t τ) : t.Value ∨ ∃ t', t ⭢βᵛ t' := by
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  have lc := der.wf.2.1
  induction der <;> subst eq
  case var => simp_all
  case abs => exact .inl (.abs lc)
  case tabs => exact .inl (.tabs lc)
  case sub _ _ ih => exact ih rfl lc
  case' app l r ih_l ih_r =>
    have lc₂ := r.wf.2.1
    rcases ih_l rfl l.wf.2.1 with val | ⟨_, red⟩
    case' inl =>
      obtain ⟨_, _, rfl⟩ := l.canonical_form_abs val
      rcases ih_r rfl lc₂ with val₂ | ⟨_, red₂⟩
  case' tapp der _ ih =>
    cases lc
    rename_i lc₁ lc₂
    rcases ih rfl lc₁ with val | ⟨_, red⟩
    case' inl => obtain ⟨_, _, rfl⟩ := der.canonical_form_tabs val
  case' let' _ _ ih _ =>
    obtain ⟨lc₁, body⟩ := body_let.mp lc
    rcases ih rfl lc₁ with val | ⟨_, red⟩
  case' inl der _ ih | inr der _ ih =>
    rcases ih rfl der.wf.2.1 with val | ⟨_, red⟩
  case' case der _ _ ih _ _ =>
    obtain ⟨lc₁, body₂, body₃⟩ := body_case.mp lc
    rcases ih rfl lc₁ with val | ⟨_, red⟩
    case' inl =>
      obtain ⟨_, h | h⟩ := der.canonical_form_sum val <;> subst h <;> cases val
  all_goals
    first
    | solve | left; constructor; assumption
    | right
      refine ⟨_, ?_⟩
      solve_by_elim [Red.abs, Red.tabs, Red.appₗ, Red.appᵣ, Red.tapp,
        Red.let_bind, Red.let_body, Red.inl, Red.inr, Red.case, Red.case_inl, Red.case_inr,
        Value.lc]

lemma Typing.progress (der : Typing [] t τ) : t.Value ∨ ∃ t', t ⭢βᵛ t' := by
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  have lc := der.wf.2.1
  induction der <;> subst eq
  case var => simp_all
  case abs => exact .inl (.abs lc)
  case tabs => exact .inl (.tabs lc)
  case sub _ _ ih => exact ih rfl lc
  case' app l r ih_l ih_r =>
    have lc₂ := r.wf.2.1
    rcases ih_l rfl l.wf.2.1 with val | ⟨_, red⟩
    case' inl =>
      obtain ⟨_, _, rfl⟩ := l.canonical_form_abs val
      rcases ih_r rfl lc₂ with val₂ | ⟨_, red₂⟩
  case' tapp der _ ih =>
    cases lc
    rename_i lc₁ lc₂
    rcases ih rfl lc₁ with val | ⟨_, red⟩
    case' inl => obtain ⟨_, _, rfl⟩ := der.canonical_form_tabs val
  case' let' _ _ ih _ =>
    obtain ⟨lc₁, body⟩ := body_let.mp lc
    rcases ih rfl lc₁ with val | ⟨_, red⟩
  case' inl der _ ih | inr der _ ih =>
    rcases ih rfl der.wf.2.1 with val | ⟨_, red⟩
  case' case der _ _ ih _ _ =>
    obtain ⟨lc₁, body₂, body₃⟩ := body_case.mp lc
    rcases ih rfl lc₁ with val | ⟨_, red⟩
    case inl =>
      obtain ⟨_, h | h⟩ := der.canonical_form_sum val <;> subst h <;> cases val
      · exact .inr ⟨_, .case_inl ‹_› body₂ body₃⟩
      · exact .inr ⟨_, .case_inr ‹_› body₂ body₃⟩
  all_goals
    first
    | solve | left; constructor; assumption
    | right
      refine ⟨_, ?_⟩
      solve_by_elim [Red.abs, Red.tabs, Red.appₗ, Red.appᵣ, Red.tapp,
        Red.let_bind, Red.let_body, Red.inl, Red.inr, Red.case, Red.case_inl, Red.case_inr,
        Value.lc]

  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  have lc := der.wf.2.1

  case app l r ih_l ih_r =>

    · exact ⟨_, .appₗ r.wf.2.1 hl⟩

    cases lc with | tapp lc₁ lc₂ =>

  case let' _ _ ih _ =>
    obtain ⟨lc₁, body⟩ := body_let.mp lc
    have := ih rfl lc₁
